result.title: Sophon: A Procedural Diagnostic for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
result.comment: NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). 10 page main text, 44 pages total. Code and data: https://github.com/zgazak/sophon
result.summary: Open-weight Vision-Language Models (VLMs) score 85-94% on spatial benchmarks (BLINK Spatial, What's Up CLEVR) yet collapse to chance on simple geometric questions when object, scene, and texture priors are stripped away. We introduce and open-source Sophon, a procedurally generated diagnostic of paired colored point-cloud stimuli across three coordinate systems (1D linear, 2D Cartesian, 2D polar) and four question types (binary, categorical, comparative, quantitative). Across four open architectures (LLaVA-NeXT, LLaVA-OneVision, Qwen2.5-VL, Idefics3), accuracy clusters at 47-52% while frontier models (Opus 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-5.4) clear 77-83% and humans reach 84-94%. We use linear probes and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) to trace the open-weight failures. Probes of the vision encoder (ViT) and language decoder (LLM) recover Sophon spatial information at 83-85% and 80-86% accuracy, respectively, and the language tower's reasoning circuit answers text-only controls (point clouds as sets of coordinates) at +40 pp over visual stimuli. Language tower per-layer attention attribution localizes visual integration to mid-stack layers. At readout, models elevate the correct answer-set tokens but select among them randomly. We localize the mechanism by tuning individual and grouped components across every architecture's stack, including the vision tower (ViT workspace and reader), the projector, and the language tower (LLM workspace and reader). These experiments demonstrate that this mid-stack workspace holds circuitry capable of organizing the spatial signal so that the frozen reader can decode it. LoRA fine-tuning adjusts that circuitry such that 7B-class VLMs answer Sophon spatial reasoning questions at frontier aggregate accuracy. This work suggests that these models do not have a capability gap for spatial reasoning but suffer from a routing bottleneck that targeted fine-tuning repairs.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出程序化生成的点云空间推理诊断集 Sophon（三种坐标系、四类题型），发现开源 VLM 在剥离物体与场景先验后准确率跌至近随机，并用线性探针、LoRA 与逐层注意力归因定位失败环节。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接关系视觉细节是否保留在内部状态以及答案是否真正使用该内容：ViT 与 LLM 探针可解码空间信息、文本坐标对照显著优于视觉刺激、读出处正确答案词被抬升却随机选择，提示「信息可解码但未被路由/使用」的瓶颈，可供核查其与 LVR 视觉旁路、贡献分配的关系；中段 workspace 的定位结论也值得对照 latent 状态生成的层级假设。
